verdict.rationale: The only mobile evidence is first-party: Reflect has an iOS app with a lock-screen widget that starts an audio memo in one tap. That shows a native iOS app with some capture ability, but says nothing about whether it is full-featured or a stripped-down companion. missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, evidence that search and linking/backlinks work on mobile, evidence of feature parity with desktop, independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
